in_sanskrit.name: Ketanraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Jewel of mind, brilliant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ketanraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ketanraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ketana' which means 'jewel' and 'raj' which means 'king' or 'ruler'. This name is often given to a child who is considered to be the jewel of his parents' minds or the future ruler of their family. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known as the 'Lord of the Mind' or 'Ketan Bhagwan'. This name is also associated with Lord Ganesha, the God of wisdom and knowledge.
